continuity._what: What must not change between cuts.
standing_rules: The lamp stays where it is. Its flame moves; its position does not.
Daśaratha's ring is on the right hand in every hand detail, in every film.
The throne is occupied in films 1–2 and empty from film 3 onward. It is never re-occupied.
Viśvāmitra's staff is planted at his right through films 1–4. It moves once, in film 5.
The sage's cloth and seated posture do not change across four films — that stillness is the performance and a shifted fold breaks it.
Once the king steps down in film 3, he does not return to the dais in any later shot.

per_join.continuous: The frame is IDENTICAL across the join — same plate, same grade, same room tone. Not a similar frame: the same one.
per_join.hard: Location or time has changed. Room tone changes with it.

never: Do not compose a heroic frame of Rāma. No low angle, no rim light, no slow push onto his
Do not state or imply his colour in narration or caption.
Do not let Rāma lead. The order is fixed.
Do not show the mother's face at beat 6. Hands are enough and she is not this film's subject.
Do not have the king weep, call out, or run after them. He stands in the door.
Do not put a triumphal chord on the gate. It is a gate.
Do not end on the father. End on the road.
